project.name: lq-skills
project.description: Curated collection of harness-agnostic agent skills for legal work built by the Legal Quants community (~100 lawyer-builders across 17+ jurisdictions) — transparent, version-controlled markdown skill definitions with evals, spanning jurisdiction-specific review, citation verification, and statutory analysis.

nodes.name: Litigation Document Review
nodes.summary: England and Wales-centred litigation skills that quality-control the core artefacts of a civil case: Particulars of Claim against CPR 16/PD 16, witness statements against PD 57AC, disclosure lists under the CPR, appellate drafts against public judicial-preference signals, and sourced chronologies built from case papers. Every flow ends in a confidence-banded report for a supervising lawyer and refuses to certify merits, truth, or compliance. Adjacent case-analysis tooling (adversarial case-file analysis, UK corporate-registry investigation, claim-economics modelling) supports the same litigation practice.

businessRules: Reports carry confidence bands and never certify merits, truth, privilege calls, or disclosure compliance
Reviews are grounded in user-supplied documents or cited public sources, never model memory
CPR 16/PD 16, PD 57AC, and disclosure-order context frame each check; statement-of-truth signing is out of scope
crossDomainInteractions: Hands pleadings, skeletons, and statements to the citation-integrity domain as a pre-filing audit gate
Chronology output feeds statement-of-facts drafting, and reviewer markups on litigation drafts are collated by the drafting domain

nodes.name: Contract Review & Negotiation Support
nodes.summary: Perspective-calibrated review skills for commercial agreements: seven-pass SaaS and commercial-purchase MSA reviews, one-way NDA review, regime-aware DPA/BAA checklist review, and clause-level contract Q&A. The shared review pattern pairs a tiered issue checklist with a red-flag catalogue and a Critical/Material/Minor severity rubric, ending in findings logs, redline language, and negotiation fallbacks for counsel.

businessRules: Findings are graded Critical/Material/Minor via an explicit severity rubric
Every review is calibrated to the client perspective: vendor/customer, buyer/supplier, recipient/discloser, controller/processor
Material gaps get proposed redline language with clause-level citations; named-counsel sign-off headers are mandatory where defined
crossDomainInteractions: Redline language from findings is applied as native Word tracked changes by the drafting domain tooling
DPA Checklist Review receives escalations from the privacy domain vendor-policy triage

nodes.name: Privacy & Regulatory Compliance
nodes.summary: Compliance counseling skills with the US state privacy navigator as flagship: deterministic 20-state applicability triage, controller/processor status determination, strictest-rule conflict-of-laws synthesis, enforcement-precedent-matched gap analysis, and citation-audited DOCX memoranda. The domain also covers regime-aware vendor privacy-policy triage, NIST AI RMF assessments with verbatim anchors, deadline extraction from regulatory client alerts, and local-first AI-workspace confidentiality audits.

entities: NIST AI RMF subcategory / GAI action ID
businessRules: Applicability thresholds are evaluated deterministically by script (applicability_check.py), not by the model
Multi-state conflicts resolve to the strictest-rule ceiling with an identified controlling state
Memos must pass the citation audit before delivery; NIST anchors are quoted verbatim by Subcategory and Action ID
Workspace audits must map every network path, including BYOK model-provider calls, and disclose exactly what leaves the machine
crossDomainInteractions: Vendor-policy triage red flags escalate into the contract domain DPA Checklist Review
The navigator citation_audit.py applies the registry-wide citation-discipline principle to privacy memos

nodes.name: Citation Integrity & Statutory Analysis
nodes.summary: Anti-hallucination and authority-discipline skills: verifying that cited UK cases exist on Find Case Law/BAILII, that Singapore citations resolve on eLitigation and statutory references against a retrieval backend, that cited sources actually support the propositions asserted, and that US statutes are read correctly via a definitions-first interpretation framework. The standing rule across the family is never verify from model memory. Jurisdiction research modules (US customs/trade, California property tax, foreign-law research, text provenance) share the same source-grounding discipline.

entities: authority source (Find Case Law, BAILII, eLitigation)
businessRules: Verification from model memory is a hard fail: sources must be live or user-supplied
Proposition checking targets citation misuse and overstatement, not mere existence of the authority
Escalation paths cover Scotland/Northern Ireland/tribunal materials and unverifiable authorities; statutory analysis is US-only and halts-and-routes outside scope
crossDomainInteractions: Operates as the pre-filing quality gate on drafts produced or reviewed in the litigation domain
Citation-discipline principles are reused by the privacy domain memo audit script

nodes.name: Document Drafting & Assembly
nodes.summary: Skills that produce or transform legal documents rather than review them: the CoQuill seven-phase template-driven assembly pipeline (analyzer, renderer, and transcriber sub-agents around Jinja2 templates), multi-reviewer DOCX feedback collation, batch playbook-driven contract redlining, legal translation across language pairs, and plain-language rewriting for non-legal audiences. A Singapore tracked-changes tooling family (redlines, superdoc-redlines, office-word-diff) supplies the native Word revision machinery. Output is always a draft requiring legal review.

businessRules: Rendered documents carry a mandatory draft-requires-legal-review notice; unfilled placeholders fail validation
Reviewer feedback is collated, never auto-merged; every batch redline requires per-change lawyer review
Translation preserves legal effect over literal wording, with strict proper-noun and date rules and a translator-notes delegation gate
crossDomainInteractions: Applies redline language produced by contract-review findings as native Word revisions
Collates reviewer markups on litigation drafts and turns chronologies into statement-of-facts drafts

nodes.name: Skill Quality Assurance & Governance
nodes.summary: The meta-domain that keeps a 40-plus-skill, multi-author registry coherent: conversational skill authoring via skill-creator, lightweight behavioral prompt evals for prose skills, a stdlib unittest suite for the deterministic script core, adversarial multi-agent QC certificates for AI deliverables, and the contribution pipeline defined by CONTRIBUTING, PR-READINESS, and ACCESS-MODES. Legal-substance skills face a higher claim/draft/attest/review/merge bar than tooling skills.

businessRules: Legal-substance skills require the five-step claim/draft/attest/review/merge process with named attestation
Behavioral evals hard-fail on verifying from model memory or predicting legal outcomes
Skills assume no tool or credential access (ACCESS-MODES); content hygiene forbids firm, client, or personal names
Privilege guidance is propagated into every generated skill by skill-creator
crossDomainInteractions: Behavioral evals and acceptance test plans gate skills in every other domain
The deterministic test suite pins the privacy navigator script engine

edges.description: Litigation drafts reviewed here — pleadings, skeleton arguments, witness statements — are handed to the citation and proposition audits as a pre-filing quality gate before submission.

Review findings include preferred redline language that the drafting domain's tracked-changes tooling (redlines, superdoc-redlines, the Vibe Legal batch redliner) applies to DOCX files as native Word revisions.
Vendor privacy-policy triage escalates into the DPA Checklist Review when red flags warrant contract-level diligence, and navigator gap findings drive processor-contract remediation.
Chronologies built from case papers feed the statement-of-facts drafting variant, and multi-reviewer markups on litigation drafts are consolidated by the reviewer-feedback collation flow.

The navigator's citation_audit.py applies the registry-wide citation-discipline principle to privacy memos: every substantive claim must carry an inline statutory citation, mirroring the verification skills' no-memory rule.
Each UK review skill ships an evals.yaml consumed by the behavioral eval harness, asserting confidence bands and hard-fail conditions like verifying from memory.
The deterministic stdlib unittest suite (run_all.py plus five test modules over fixtures and the enforcement corpus) pins the navigator's script engine.
Contract-review skills carry acceptance test plans and 2026-05 LegalQuants QA remediation logs produced by the registry's QA process.
Adversarial QC spawns paired verification agents over AI-drafted deliverables (assembled documents, redlines, translations) before they leave the building.
